title: Gibson Assembly
author: 宏亮 董
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7h5hj86

steps.title: Prepare ice box for reagents
steps.instruction: Place a small box on ice and keep the DNA fragments and the Gibson Mix on ice until they are transferred to the metal bath or the Bio‑rad S1000™ thermocycler.

steps.title: Set up Gibson Mix reaction
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube with a final volume of 4 µL, add 2 µL Gibson Mix, X µL insert and Y µL vector such that X + Y = 2 µL and the insert‑to‑vector ratio (X:Y) is between 3:1 and 5:1. Incubate at 50 °C for 15–30 min using a metal bath or the Bio‑rad S1000™ thermocycler.

steps.title: Prepare ice box for enzyme mix
steps.instruction: Place a small box on ice and keep the DNA fragments, Gibson enzyme, and Gibson buffer on ice until they are transferred to the metal bath or the Bio‑rad S1000™ thermocycler.

steps.title: Set up Gibson enzyme reaction
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube with a final volume of 10 µL, add 1 µL Gibson enzyme, 2 µL Gibson buffer, X µL insert and Y µL vector where X = 0.02 × (vector length / vector concentration) and Y = 0.02 × (insert length / insert concentration). Incubate at 37 °C for 30–60 min using a metal bath or the Bio‑rad S1000™ thermocycler.
